method.label: Change bases and simplify the sums

annotationRationale: Change of base and the logarithm power rule simplify the summands. The arithmetic-series formula evaluates the remaining sum of integers.
sourceMethod: Followed the official change-of-base argument, simplifying each summand before evaluating the sums and canceling reciprocal logarithm ratios.

review.mathCheck: For every allowed k, the summands simplify to \(k\log_5 3\) and \(\log_3 5\). Thus the sums are \(210\log_5 3\) and \(100\log_3 5\), whose product is \(21{,}000\). Choice E and the bank key are correct; all logarithms are defined.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA solution 14, page 8: change base, apply the power rule, sum the integers, and cancel reciprocal logarithmic factors.
review.annotationCheck: The assessed logarithm skills and supporting arithmetic-series formula match the complete, reconstructible AMC 12 explanation.
